notes: Beta build 2026.08.04-678 - your saved rules now travel to the server. Every time rules are saved with the bot ON (a preset tap, the tested-rules button, or a manual Save), the app quietly mirrors the bot numbers to the worker, and the nightly server run decides picks with YOUR rules - even on days the app never opens. Switching the bot OFF clears the server copy. Requires worker w505 (paste staged); on an older worker the mirror silently does nothing and the app behaves exactly as before. View the lane at /picks?mode=mine or the admin page once w505 is live. Practice money only. Hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5).
